verdict.rationale: Docs mention the Agent SDK offering 'full control over orchestration, tool access, and permissions' and cloud/browser sessions with no local setup, suggesting some isolated execution options, but there is no explicit mention of a dedicated sandbox mode for filesystem/network isolation. Community evidence even raises security/trust concerns (e.g., 'failing to properly secure its own software', hidden anti-distillation tool injection), undermining confidence in robust sandboxing.
